visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium shot of a man in his early 30s with short black hair, wearing a light grey suit, white shirt, and brown tie. He is standing on an outdoor urban sidewalk in Japan, holding a traditional white wedding gift envelope (shugi-bukuro). He smiles at the camera, and in the background, pedestrians in winter coats walk past a parking lot sign. (2) The scene cuts to the interior of a traditional Shinto shrine. The environment is characterized by warm wood and rhythmic architectural lines. A miko (shrine maiden) in white and red ceremonial dress performs a ritual dance, first shaking a set of bells and then wielding a ceremonial sword. The couple—a bride in a white shiromuku and a groom in a black montsuki—are seated respectfully. (3) A woman in a pink floral kimono is shown briefly in a modern indoor corridor with white paneled walls, waving cheerfully. (4) The action moves to a grand reception hall with ornate gold-framed chairs and large crystal chandeliers. The man from the first phase stands at a microphone podium, champagne glass in hand, delivering a speech. The newlyweds react with laughter and smiles from their head table. (5) A series of quick cuts shows still photos and clips of the couple in a commercial kitchen; the groom, wearing a chef’s hat and white coat, is seen expertly slicing vegetables. (6) The final phase returns to the outdoors at dusk. The speaker walks along a city street with another man in a suit; they carry a bouquet of flowers and engage in a playful conversation while laughing and gesturing towards the camera.
